captions.detailed: This 3D model represents the base portion of a screw-top container featuring a helical, three-petal design. It consists of a solid circular base plate with a low inner collar, from which three wide, curved blades or 'petals' sweep upwards in a twisted spiral pattern. The inner surface of the base includes a recessed text logo, while the top edges of the spiraling petals are finished with angled cuts to facilitate smooth engagement with a matching lid.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric screw-box base in OpenSCAD with a customizable diameter, height, and wall thickness. It must feature a spiral screw mechanism composed of a user-defined number of twisting petals (such as 3) with adjustable twist angles, an optional internal reinforcement profile, and a custom recessed text logo extruded on the underside of the base.
captions.factory: The script constructs the model by combining a solid 'base' cylinder and a thin-walled inner 'box' cylinder with a 'stopper' lip. The helical screw threads are generated in the 'petals' module using 'linear_extrude' with a 'twist' parameter applied to a 2D 'screwprofile' composed of circular sector wedges. Sharp edges on the top and bottom of the twisted petals are trimmed using boolean 'difference' operations with angled wedge geometries, while a custom 2D font polygon is extruded and subtracted from the bottom of the base for the logo.
